hero.title: Three generations of keeping time
hero.story: Alberto Clocks opened in 1987 as a two-bench repair shop on Marina Road. Today we are a full-service watch repair, appraisal and retail house — still family-run, still repairing every watch by hand.
hero.quote: A watch should outlive its first owner.

timelineSection.title: From one bench to three stores

timeline.title: The first bench
timeline.text: Alberto Okon opens a small repair shop on Marina Road, Lagos Island.

timeline.title: Official retailer
timeline.text: We become an authorised dealer for Citizen, Bulova and Michael Kors.

timeline.title: Lekki & Ikeja
timeline.text: Two new stores and a dedicated servicing workshop open.

timeline.title: Online
timeline.text: Our full catalogue, price list and store locator go online.
